name: creator-store-pet-pack-visuals
description: Verify the user-approved free pack contributes exactly eight preloaded visual-only pet templates, all normal and premium Inventory previews match those templates, the raw 3,003-part pack is absent, and premium companions use the same bounded models.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local cfg=require(RS.GameConfig) local polish=require(RS.PolishConfig) local builder=require(RS.FistVisualBuilder) local expected={['Forest Pup']={'Sanitized_ForestPupPet','Dowodle'},['Miner Cat']={'Sanitized_MinerCatPet','Catmouse'},['Crystal Fox']={'Sanitized_CrystalFoxPet','Ocelot'},['Lava Dragon']={'Sanitized_LavaDragonPet','Mythic Autumn Dragon'},['Secret Titan Golem']={'Sanitized_SecretTitanGolemPet','Dark Guardian'},['Crimson Phoenix']={'Sanitized_CrimsonPhoenixPet','Enraged Phoenix'},['Storm Wyvern']={'Sanitized_StormWyvernPet','Electra Hydra'},['Celestial Guardian']={'Sanitized_CelestialGuardianPet','Mythic Radiant One'}} local packSources={['Dowodle']=true,['Catmouse']=true,['Ocelot']=true,['Mythic Autumn Dragon']=true,['Dark Guardian']=true,['Enraged Phoenix']=true,['Electra Hydra']=true,['Mythic Radiant One']=true} local folder=RS:FindFirstChild('PunchWallExternalAssets') local found,unsafe,parts,effects=0,0,0,0 local rows={} for pet,map in pairs(expected) do local m=folder and folder:FindFirstChild(map[1]) local row={template=map[1],source=map[2],ready=false} if m then for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') then parts+=1 elseif d:IsA('ParticleEmitter') or d:IsA('Trail') or d:IsA('Beam') or d:IsA('Light') then effects+=1 elseif d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('BindableEvent') or d:IsA('BindableFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') or d:IsA('Humanoid') or d:IsA('AnimationController') or d:IsA('Animator') then unsafe+=1 end end row.ready=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')==pet and m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')==map[2] and tostring(m:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId'))=='70715599928632' and m:GetAttribute('PreloadedOnly')==true and builder.IsSanitizedVisual(m) if row.ready then found+=1 end end rows[pet]=row end local configured=0 local configOk=true for _,pet in ipairs(cfg.AllPets()) do local map=expected[pet.name] if map then configured+=1 configOk=configOk and pet.templateName==map[1] and pet.packModel==map[2] end end local preloaded=0 for _,entry in ipairs(polish.ExternalVisualTemplates) do if tonumber(entry.assetId)==70715599928632 then preloaded+=1 configOk=configOk and entry.preloadedOnly==true and packSources[entry.sourceModel]==true end end local ok=folder and found==8 and configured==8 and preloaded==8 and unsafe==0 and parts<=90 and effects<=16 and folder:GetAttribute('PetPackTemplateCount')==8 and workspace:FindFirstChild('Pet pack')==nil and workspace:FindFirstChild('Pets')==nil and workspace:FindFirstChild('BGC Pets Pack')==nil and configOk return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok==true,found=found,configured=configured,preloaded=preloaded,unsafe=unsafe,parts=parts,effects=effects,rawPack=workspace:FindFirstChild('Pet pack')~=nil,rows=rows})

steps.label: eight extracted pack templates are exact safe and bounded
wait for runtime templates and Inventory

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation local names={'Forest Pup','Miner Cat','Crystal Fox','Lava Dragon','Secret Titan Golem','Crimson Phoenix','Storm Wyvern','Celestial Guardian'} a:Invoke('Reset') local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{PetInventoryJSON=H:JSONEncode(names),EquippedPetsJSON='[]',LockedPetsJSON='[]',DiscoveredPetsJSON=H:JSONEncode(names)}) local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local ok=s.ok==true and root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplatePreloadedOnlyCount')==8 and root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplateMissingPreloadedOnlyCount')==0 and root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplatePreloadedOnlyFailClosed')==true return H:JSONEncode({ok=ok,inventory=s.PetInventoryJSON,preloaded=root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplatePreloadedOnlyCount'),missing=root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplateMissingPreloadedOnlyCount'),failClosed=root:GetAttribute('ExternalTemplatePreloadedOnlyFailClosed')})

steps.label: runtime keeps all preloaded children and never loads the complete pack

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD') local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation') local expected={['Forest Pup']='Dowodle',['Miner Cat']='Catmouse',['Crystal Fox']='Ocelot',['Lava Dragon']='Mythic Autumn Dragon',['Secret Titan Golem']='Dark Guardian',['Crimson Phoenix']='Enraged Phoenix',['Storm Wyvern']='Electra Hydra',['Celestial Guardian']='Mythic Radiant One'} a:Invoke('OpenInventory') a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory','Pets') a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') a:Invoke('SetInventoryRarity','All') a:Invoke('RequestAction',{action='RequestSync'}) task.wait(1) local grid=g.GameMenu.FunctionalInventory.InventoryWindow.InventoryBody.InventoryGridPane.InventoryGrid local cards,matched,unsafe=0,0,0 local seen={} for _,card in ipairs(grid:GetChildren()) do if card:IsA('GuiObject') and card.Visible and card:GetAttribute('InventoryCategory')=='Pets' then cards+=1 local name=card:GetAttribute('PreviewPetName') local vp=card:FindFirstChild('ItemPetPreview',true) local world=vp and vp:FindFirstChild('PetPreviewWorld') local model=world and world:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Model') if model then for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then unsafe+=1 end end end local good=expected[name] and card:GetAttribute('ArtMode')=='ModelMatchedViewportV1' and vp and vp:GetAttribute('PreviewReady')==true and model and model:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')==name and model:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')==expected[name] and tostring(model:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId'))=='70715599928632' if good and not seen[name] then matched+=1 seen[name]=true end end end return H:JSONEncode({ok=cards==8 and matched==8 and unsafe==0,cards=cards,matched=matched,unsafe=unsafe,seen=seen})

steps.label: all eight Inventory cards render the exact equipped-model source

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation a:Invoke('Reset') local granted=0 for _,name in ipairs({'Crimson Phoenix','Storm Wyvern','Celestial Guardian'}) do if a:Invoke('GrantPremiumPet',name).ok then granted+=1 end end return H:JSONEncode({ok=granted==3,granted=granted})

steps.label: equip all three premium pack pets

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local folder=workspace:WaitForChild(p.Name..' Client Companions',5) local expected={['Crimson Phoenix']='Enraged Phoenix',['Storm Wyvern']='Electra Hydra',['Celestial Guardian']='Mythic Radiant One'} local matched,unsafe=0,0 local centers={} for _,m in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do if m:IsA('Model') and expected[m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName')] then local name=m:GetAttribute('PetDefinitionName') for _,d in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('LuaSourceContainer') or d:IsA('Sound') or d:IsA('Tool') or d:IsA('RemoteEvent') or d:IsA('RemoteFunction') or d:IsA('ClickDetector') or d:IsA('ProximityPrompt') then unsafe+=1 end end if m:GetAttribute('SourcePackModelName')==expected[name] and tostring(m:GetAttribute('CreatorStorePackAssetId'))=='70715599928632' and m:GetAttribute('VisualSource')=='ExternalTemplate' then matched+=1 end centers[name]=m:GetBoundingBox().Position end end local minDistance=999 for _,a in pairs(centers) do for _,b in pairs(centers) do if a~=b then minDistance=math.min(minDistance,(a-b).Magnitude) end end end return H:JSONEncode({ok=matched==3 and unsafe==0 and minDistance>=1.1,matched=matched,unsafe=unsafe,minDistance=minDistance,centers=centers})
